repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires the condition to be sustained for 10 minutes (600,000 ms). The candidate uses a 1000 ms wrapper period with a threshold of 6001, which triggers the action at 6,000,000 ms (6001 * 1000). The IR action occurs at 600,000 ms. The error is using the wrong wrapper period (1000 instead of 100) and an incorrect threshold calculation for that period.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the wrapper period to 100 ms and adjusted the threshold to 6001 (6000 ticks + 1). This ensures the action fires exactly at 600,000 ms when the condition has been true for 10 minutes, matching the IR specification.
